events.text: Goal! Lille 1, Real Betis 0. Ayase Ueda (Lille) header from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ethan Mbappé.
Goal! Lille 1, Real Betis 1. Marc Bartra (Real Betis) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pablo Fornals with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Lille 2, Real Betis 1. Alexsandro (Lille) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Gaëtan Perrin with a cross following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Benjamin André (Lille).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Lille. Ngal'ayel Mukau replaces Nabil Bentaleb.
Second Half begins Lille 2, Real Betis 1.
Goal! Lille 2, Real Betis 2. Marc Bartra (Real Betis) header from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Isco with a cross following a set piece situation.
Goal! Lille 2, Real Betis 3. Troy Parrott (Real Betis) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rodrigo Riquelme.
